changes: Added story-scoped scope contracts, scope_contract_set/show/check/acknowledge CLI handlers, changed-file scope checking, REVIEW/TEST/DONE lifecycle gate integration, command policy/config/process-fact registration, and scope-contract smoke regression coverage including partial update preservation.
usage: Use scope_contract_set to define allowed/protected paths, scope_contract_check to inspect pass/warn/fail state, scope_contract_acknowledge to record explicit scope expansion, then rely on story_advance REVIEW/TEST/DONE to run the scope gate automatically.
expectedOutcome: Users see Scope gate: pass/warn/fail with changed files and violations; out-of-scope changes cannot silently pass through lifecycle gates.
actualTranscript: scope_contract_check returned status pass in enforce mode with 28 changed files and 0 unacknowledged violations. REVIEW and TEST story_advance printed Scope gate: pass before transition. validate passed with 15/15 verification coverage.
outcomeDiff: No remaining user-visible gap. A partial-update defect found during review was fixed and revalidated before delivery.
limitations: No known limitation for the implemented post-diff lifecycle gate. Pre-tool blocking remains intentionally out of scope for this story.
pitfalls: Claude Code tool-mode review stalled twice, so the refreshed reviews used tools-disabled concise prompts. The review caught a real partial-update bug where omitted scope arrays could be cleared; it is now covered by smoke tests.
